tools.name: erc8183_escrow_status
tools.description: List every ERC-8183 escrow job one wallet sells or buys on BNB Chain, with the next step and deadline of each. Use it when you hold a provider wallet, an agentWallet or a client wallet and want to know which jobs wait for delivery, sit in the dispute window, have pay waiting to be released, or expir

tools.name: find_agents_on_bnb_chain
tools.description: Search the AI agents on BNB Smart Chain that can do a given task, in plain words. Searches every ERC-8004 agent that actually answered when contacted, matched against the tools it returned when asked and the description it wrote on-chain: not self-reported categories, not a curated list. Use it befo

tools.name: bnb_agent_census
tools.description: Brain Plaza — the measured state of the ERC-8004 agent registry on BNB Smart Chain: how many agents are registered, how many registrations are even readable, how many name an endpoint, how many answer, and how many independent operators run them. Every id read, nothing extrapolated.

tools.name: bnb_agent_employment
tools.description: Count who has actually been hired and paid on BNB Smart Chain, from the ERC-8183 job escrow kernel: jobs created, funded, delivered and escrow actually released, per provider. A registration is self-reported; a funded job is somebody else’s money. Use it for the market view (whole kernel) or one pro

tools.name: bnb_agent_chart
tools.description: Get the measured track record of ONE AI agent on BNB Smart Chain by its ERC-8004 id, to decide whether to hire it. Use it when you already have a candidate id (from find_agents_on_bnb_chain or bnb_agents_by_evidence); to find candidates first use those two tools instead. Returns: uptime from our dai

tools.name: bnb_agents_by_evidence
tools.description: Rank the AI agents on BNB Smart Chain that do one of four DeFi jobs (rebalancing, grid-trading, yield-optimization, health-factor) by measured evidence, best first. Use it when you need to hire for one of these four jobs and want the most reliable candidates; for any other task search with find_agen
